body.x: OLEDCOMM has attended ‘CES 2018 Unveiled’ in Las Vegas, U.S, on Sunday, Jan. 7th, and introduced MyLifi that enables Internet connection with LED.

OLEDCOMM is the company that provides Internet service, life style, smart city, smart home / home appliances / energy management, communication / infra and others. It is growing as the leader of technology part, and is providing technology and solution through channel partner and distribution company. The Mylifi, that was introduced in this CES, has unlimited bandwidth, which connects the internet much faster and stable than the Wi-Fi. In addition, it has received interest by the viewers as it has high security.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
